summary: Jordyn Listro is a veteran professional soccer midfielder and the captain of Tampa Bay Sun FC, whom she led to the inaugural USL Super League championship in June 2025. Her elite standing is anchored by prior experience in the NWSL with Orlando Pride and Kansas City Current, and two senior caps for the Canadian National Team. On social media, Listro maintains a moderate audience centered on Instagram (@jordylistro) with nearly 30,000 followers, though she boasts a highly engaged fanbase with an above-average 7% engagement rate. Culturally, she enjoys strong regional popularity in Florida and Canada, bolstered by her marriage to golfer Cristian DiMarco. Listro's highly compelling comeback narrative—transitioning from professional soccer to medical device sales during a career hiatus, then returning to reach the national team and captain a champion franchise—provides immense storytelling power. This narrative has propelled significant commercial momentum in 2026, highlighted by her signings as a prominent brand ambassador for Gainbridge and her feature in a national Under Armour campaign. Major missing information includes private platform metrics such as video retention, saves, shares, and exact ROI performance for her commercial campaigns, resulting in some evaluated social and commercial sub-signals being marked as missing.
